I was so happy with my experience at Groovy Tails Dog Spaw! They truly listened to what I wanted for my maltipoo’s haircut and nailed it — exactly how I envisioned. I love how easy it is to book online, and from drop-off to pick-up it only took about 2.5 hours, which is amazing compared to other places. One of my favorite things is that they notify you as soon as your pup is ready instead of keeping them kenneled for hours. You can tell they really care about both the dogs and their owners. I’ll definitely be using them from now on — highly recommend!
Highly recommend.  They always do such a great job on my pup!

I went to this shop today to get my dogs very long nails clipped and Dremeled, I let them know before hand that the nails were very long. they started by picking my dog up by her collar and one arm under her stomach and I immediately told them that I was not okay with that because you should NEVER lift a dog by the collar. The man doing her nails never once tried to comfort her or let her know that it was safe which I have never seen before he just began snatching at her paws for the trim even though she was clearly very scared of him. He then cut her quicks… and then put quick clot on he bleeding paws and when I said something the woman behind the counter went to check and said “no blood he just did it as a precaution” why would he put it on one paw as a precaution.. she was super uncomfortable the whole time and has never reacted this badly to a nail trim in the last 8 years. This place is unprofessional and nothing like the K9 club despite having the same owner. Do better for your dogs than I did with this mistake.

This company has done a good job with our dog, I'm pleased with the haircut and shampoo that he got as well as the nail trim and teeth brushing. You can select whatever services you would like. The staff is friendly and tries to make sure that you are satisfied before you check out.
Professional groomers, friendly staff and fair pricing.

Alejandra is very helpful on answering all of my questions and is always so helpful.  Scheduling is always easy and quick! We have a standard poodle who is nervous but they always do a great job with him!!! Thank groovy tails team for the love and care you guys give Turbo!
We absolutely love this place and our dogs do too!

I visited Groovy Tails Dog Spaw with my dog Winston and was thoroughly impressed. The staff were incredibly welcoming and handled Winston with great care, making sure he was comfortable throughout his grooming session. The attention to detail in Winston's grooming was top-notch, leaving him looking and feeling fantastic.

What really stands out is Groovy Tails' commitment to customer service. They always manage to accommodate our scheduling needs, making each visit seamless and stress-free. The facility is clean, and the environment is perfectly set up for pets.

In short, Groovy Tails Dog Spaw provides a superior grooming service with a personal touch that both Winston and I greatly appreciate. Highly recommended for pet owners who value quality and care.
The only place we take our golden retriever.
